answer.conflict_group_limit: These are product-owned vocabulary choice groups, not a general rule for arbitrary configuration keys. In particular, the var choice summary says the three csharp_style_var_* editorconfig categories are independent and may be combined; the vocabulary group must not be used to reject such key combinations. omitted_boolean_interpretation.known_choice_complete_data: For a registered ID in this complete vocabulary, if a declared exactly-one Boolean map has complete coverage and its property set omits the ID, the value is false. This applies only to that declared map and vocabulary scope.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unknown_id: No Boolean value follows for an ID outside the registered members, even when the vocabulary is complete; it is not a known choice.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.incomplete_data: When membership or map coverage is incomplete, omission means unknown rather than false.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unavailable_property: An explicitly unavailable property has no usable Boolean value; preserve the unavailable state rather than treating omission as false.
